definitions.ask: When a block-ID rename is undone in its own note, should the plugin also revert that rename's links in other notes?
definitions.why: One undo then means one whole rename, and no link is ever left pointing at a vanished ID.

definitions.ask: Should vault-sync also send a desktop notification when an open task with no inbound links disappears?
definitions.why: Bryan deletes unlinked scratch tasks often; status and the log still record every one.
